title: The Last Ascent

story_provenance.canonical_status: Original late-game scenario, not canonical Tuxemon endgame.
story_provenance.scope: Walkable dialogue and quest playground; no authored combat outcome or measured model result.
story_provenance.integration_note: Spawn moved below companion collision footprint. Classifier descriptions clarify the same existing actions; human preview/meaning confirmation remains required.

initial_state.inventory_semantics: bitmask: aid kit=1, crystal=2, permit=4, supply pack=8

npcs.name: Professor
npcs.opening: The Crown trial starts at dusk. Your Rockitten is Earth-type. Prepare your route and your team; the injured scout also needs help.

replies.label: earth_plan
replies.text: Rockitten is Earth-type. Study the trial briefing, then choose your opening carefully. Type alone does not guarantee a win. I have marked your preparation complete.
replies.utterance: How should I prepare my Earth-type Rockitten for the Crown trial?
replies.classifier_label: ask how to prepare Earth-type Rockitten for the championship

replies.label: safe_plan
replies.text: Travel through Supply Terrace and Echo Ravine. Get a permit from Warden Vale, and check the scout before the trial. That route gives you time to prepare.
replies.utterance: Give me a safe preparation plan, including the injured scout.
replies.classifier_label: request a safe travel and preparation plan including the injured scout

replies.label: rush_trial
replies.text: You can walk to Crown Approach now. The trial steward still needs your permit, supplies, route report, and preparation notes. Rushing skips none of those duties.
replies.utterance: I want to rush straight to the Crown trial.
replies.classifier_label: rush straight to the championship without preparation

replies.label: type_correction
replies.text: You are right to question that. Rockitten is Earth-type. This camp has no verified type information for your other companion; ask about Rockitten or the route.
replies.utterance: Rockitten is Earth, not Water. Correct the type in your advice.
replies.classifier_label: correct the claim that Rockitten is Water-type instead of Earth-type

replies.label: epilogue
replies.text: Your permit, supplies, safe route, and tactics are ready. The rescued scout has reached camp. The Crown trial steward accepts your entry; dawn is yours to face.
replies.utterance: All duties are complete. Register me for the Crown trial.
replies.classifier_label: register for the championship after completing every duty

replies.label: prof_unknown
replies.text: I need a clearer question. Are you asking about Rockitten, the preparation route, or entering the trial? I cannot promise a battle result.
replies.utterance: What does the zhurble tactic do?
replies.classifier_label: ask an unrecognized or ambiguous question outside the known tactics and route

npcs.name: Quartermaster
npcs.opening: I can exchange your crystal for one supply pack. The scout needs your aid kit. Our camp has one spare pack, so choose an exact quantity.

replies.label: buy_one
replies.text: One crystal for one supply pack, agreed. I have reserved the pack for your ascent. Keep the aid kit ready for the scout.
replies.utterance: Trade my crystal for exactly one supply pack.
replies.classifier_label: trade one crystal for exactly one supply pack

replies.label: buy_many
replies.text: Two packs are unavailable. Our camp has one spare pack. Ask for exactly one if you want the crystal exchange.
replies.utterance: I need two supply packs, not one.
replies.classifier_label: request two or more supply packs rather than one

replies.label: refuse_trade
replies.text: Keep your crystal. I have made no trade. If you change your mind, ask for one pack. The injured scout still needs help.
replies.utterance: Do not trade my crystal. I want to keep it.
replies.classifier_label: refuse the trade and keep the crystal

replies.label: check_stock
replies.text: You arrived with an aid kit and a crystal. A supply pack appears in your bag after the exchange. Check your journal for current items before another request.
replies.utterance: What do I have, and what can you trade?
replies.classifier_label: ask which supplies and quantities the quartermaster has available

replies.label: already_supplied
replies.text: You already arranged the camp supply pack. I have no second pack to offer. Take the reserved pack to Crown Approach.
replies.utterance: I already got the supply pack. Can I get another?
replies.classifier_label: ask for another pack after already obtaining supplies

replies.label: quarter_unknown
replies.text: Name the item and quantity. I offer one supply pack for a crystal. I cannot price unfamiliar items.
replies.utterance: How many flarn stones buy a moon parcel?
replies.classifier_label: ask an unclear trade question without identifying the item or quantity

npcs.name: Tracker Iona
npcs.opening: A rare companion crossed this ravine. I called it Luma, then noticed the tag read Lumi. Its footprints head uphill, away from the soaked shortcut.

replies.label: correct_name
replies.text: Lumi, yes. Thank you for the correction. I have copied the exact tag into your journal. Its footprints skirt the water and lead toward Crown Approach.
replies.utterance: The tag says Lumi, not Luma. Please correct the name.
replies.classifier_label: correct the creature tag from Luma to Lumi

replies.label: follow_clue
replies.text: Follow the dry eastern trail toward Crown Approach. I found footprints there, but I cannot promise you will meet Lumi. Tell Warden Vale what you learned.
replies.utterance: Where did the tagged creature go?
replies.classifier_label: ask where the creature went or where its footprints lead

replies.label: unknown_name
replies.text: I have no record of a creature named Vorpax. I can describe the tagged companion I saw. Give me a spelling or a detail before I identify anything.
replies.utterance: Is the creature Vorpax? I have never heard that name here.
replies.classifier_label: ask about an unfamiliar creature name outside Luma and Lumi

replies.label: leave_creature
replies.text: We can leave the companion alone. The ascent needs a safe route report, and your aid kit belongs with the injured scout.
replies.utterance: Do not chase Lumi. Leave the creature alone.
replies.classifier_label: choose to leave the creature alone and stop following it

replies.label: safe_route
replies.text: With the footprints checked, I can confirm a dry passage around the flooded cut. I have marked the safe route in your journal. Bring the report to Warden Vale.
replies.utterance: I checked the clue. Mark a safe route around the water.
replies.classifier_label: request the dry safe trail after checking the creature clue

replies.label: tracker_unknown
replies.text: Tell me whether you want the tag spelling, the footprints, or a safe route. I will keep an unfamiliar name unresolved.
replies.utterance: Explain the thing from before.
replies.classifier_label: ask an unclear question about the clue or creature without a clear subject

npcs.name: Medic Ren
npcs.opening: The scout sprained an ankle while helping your companion. Use the aid kit, escort the scout to camp, then return to your ascent.

replies.label: rescue_scout
replies.text: You apply the aid kit and guide the scout along the dry path to camp. Ren takes over there. Your companion rests beside you, ready to continue.
replies.utterance: Use my aid kit and escort the injured scout back to camp.
replies.classifier_label: use the aid kit and escort the injured scout back to camp

replies.label: prioritize_trial
replies.text: The trial can wait until dusk. The scout cannot walk safely alone. Return with your aid kit when you are ready; the rescue remains unfinished.
replies.utterance: Ignore the scout for now. I want to enter the trial first.
replies.classifier_label: prioritize entering the trial over helping the injured scout

replies.label: help_companion
replies.text: Your companion needs a short rest beside Ren. Its condition does not require the scout kit. You can stay together while escorting the scout.
replies.utterance: I need to help my companion too. Can I do both?
replies.classifier_label: ask to help the player companion rather than the injured scout

replies.label: refuse_kit
replies.text: I have left your aid kit untouched. Stay with the scout or seek help from camp. Tell me clearly when you want to use the kit and begin the escort.
replies.utterance: Do not use my aid kit yet. I am not ready to escort anyone.
replies.classifier_label: refuse to use or give up the aid kit

replies.label: rescue_status
replies.text: The scout reached camp and Ren took over care. That duty is complete. Your companion may continue the ascent with you.
replies.utterance: I escorted the scout. Is that duty complete?
replies.classifier_label: ask whether the scout rescue duty is already complete

replies.label: medic_unknown
replies.text: Name who needs help: the injured scout or your companion. I will not spend the aid kit from an unclear request.
replies.utterance: Help them with that thing.
replies.classifier_label: ask an unclear medical or help question without naming who needs help

npcs.name: Warden Vale
npcs.opening: The flooded shortcut is closed. The marked ascent stays open. Bring a route report for a trial permit; the gate also checks your supplies and duties.

replies.label: take_shortcut
replies.text: The flooded cut remains closed. Fast water reaches the ledge, and I will not send you there. Use Tracker Iona's dry route to reach this gate.
replies.utterance: Open the flooded shortcut. I accept the risk.
replies.classifier_label: request access to the dangerous flooded shortcut

replies.label: refuse_shortcut
replies.text: Understood. You have chosen the marked ascent. Ask Iona for the dry route report, then return for your permit.
replies.utterance: Do not open the shortcut. I refuse that risk.
replies.classifier_label: reject the risky shortcut and choose the safe marked path

replies.label: get_permit
replies.text: Your safe route report is accepted. Here is your trial permit. Complete your supplies, tactics, and scout duty before asking the Professor to register your entry.
replies.utterance: I have the safe route report. Give me the trial permit.
replies.classifier_label: ask the warden to grant a championship entry permit

replies.label: gate_status
replies.text: For entry, bring a permit and supplies; complete your tactics notes and scout rescue. Your journal tracks each duty. The Professor registers you when all are complete.
replies.utterance: What is still required before I can enter?
replies.classifier_label: ask what requirements remain before the gate or permit can be obtained

replies.label: permit_again
replies.text: Your permit remains valid. You need no second permit. Finish your other duties and ask the Professor to register your trial entry.
replies.utterance: I already have a permit. Do I need another?
replies.classifier_label: ask about a permit that the player already has

replies.label: warden_unknown
replies.text: State whether you want a permit, the entry requirements, or the marked route. An unclear request will not open the flooded cut.
replies.utterance: Open that other thing over there.
replies.classifier_label: ask an unclear gate or travel question with no identifiable request

quests.title: Care for the Scout
quests.goal: Use the aid kit with Medic Ren and escort the scout to camp.

quests.title: Find the Dry Passage
quests.goal: Check Iona's tag clue, then request the safe route.

quests.title: Prepare for the Crown
quests.goal: Arrange one supply pack, ask for tactics, and obtain Vale's permit.

quests.title: Enter at Dawn
quests.goal: Return to the Professor after all duties are complete.

world_consequences.description: Iona marks the dry route in the journal.
Ren confirms the scout reached camp.
One crystal leaves inventory; one supply pack enters.
Crown entry registered; gated area is eligible to open.

ranking_basis: Research design judgment, not measured user performance.
